notes.title: Traditional and Simplified Chinese Now Available!
notes.content: [h3]Au Revoir is now accessible to even more players around the world![/h3][p][/p][p]Our latest update adds full support for both [b]Simplified[/b] and [b]Traditional Chinese[/b] — a key step in bringing the game's immersive experience to a broader audience.[/p][p]Step into the year 2071 as a Sentinel working for Au Revoir Ltd. Uncover hidden truths, make impactful decisions that shape the fate of each character, and explore neon-noir environments filled with mystery, tension, and retro-futuristic vibes — now fully localized for Chinese-speaking players.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090100/0d5afc8b29a43ccf3523a1f3c605d732a7f75177.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Get ready to revisit Au Revoir with a whole new perspective.[/p]
